sum: Genco Shipping & Trading Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the ocean transportation of drybulk cargoes worldwide. It operates through two segments: major bulk and minor bulk fleet. The company owns and operates dry bulk vessels to transports iron ore, grains, coal, steel products, and other drybulk cargoes. It charters its vessels primarily to trading houses, including commodities traders; producers; and government-owned entities. Genco Shipping & Trading Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
ceo: Mr. John C. Wobensmith C.F.A. (CEO, President, Secretary & Chairman of the Board)
